title: Fully Ab Initio Finite-Size Corrections for Charged-Defect Supercell Calculations
finding: Introduces the ab initio (FNV) electrostatic correction removing spurious periodic-image interactions for charged defects.

title: First-principles calculations for point defects in solids
finding: Authoritative review of first-principles charged-defect formalism: formation energies, chemical potentials, corrections, functional/SOC choices.

title: Electrostatics-based finite-size corrections for first-principles point defect calculations
finding: Kumagai-Oba extension of FNV to anisotropic systems using atomic-site potential alignment — widely used for perovskites.

title: Unusual defect physics in CH3NH3PbI3 perovskite solar cell absorber
finding: Foundational DFT showing MAPbI3 has only shallow, low-formation-energy defects — the origin of perovskite 'defect tolerance'.

title: Accelerated discovery of stable lead-free hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites via machine learning
finding: ML-accelerated HT screening of hybrid double perovskites for thermodynamic stability and band gap.

title: New tolerance factor to predict the stability of perovskite oxides and halides
finding: New tolerance-factor descriptor (tau) predicting perovskite formability with ~92% accuracy across 576 compounds.

title: Latent Ewald summation for machine learning of long-range interactions
finding: Latent Ewald summation captures long-range electrostatics in MLIPs at near-linear cost — critical for charged defects.

title: Multi-fidelity Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Charged Point Defects
finding: Multi-fidelity MLIP scheme injecting charged-defect electrostatics to fix long-range errors for defect migration.

title: Ionic transport in hybrid lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: DFT+NEB establishing iodide-vacancy migration (~0.6 eV) as the dominant ionic-transport channel driving hysteresis.

title: How fast do defects migrate in halide perovskites: insights from on-the-fly machine-learned force fields
finding: MLIP-driven MD quantifying how fast vacancies migrate in halide perovskites at finite temperature.

title: Tracing Ion Migration in Halide Perovskites with Machine Learned Force Fields
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Neural-network-potential MD tracing cation and anion migration pathways/barriers in halide perovskites.

title: E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for data-efficient and accurate interatomic potentials
finding: NequIP: E(3)-equivariant GNN achieving DFT accuracy with orders-of-magnitude less training data.

title: A universal graph deep learning interatomic potential for the periodic table
finding: M3GNet universal potential covering the periodic table, enabling relaxation/MD of arbitrary crystals.

title: MACE: Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks for Fast and Accurate Force Fields
finding: MACE higher-order equivariant message passing — the architecture underlying the perovskite MLIP spine.

title: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling
finding: CHGNet: charge-informed universal potential encoding magnetic moments/charge states for redox-active MD.

title: A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry
finding: MACE-MP-0 foundation model: one pretrained MLIP for MD across the periodic table.

title: The Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) inorganic materials dataset and models
finding: OMat24: >100M-structure dataset with non-equilibrium/rattled configs improving foundation-model force accuracy.

title: Performance Assessment of Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Challenges and Directions for Materials’ Surfaces
finding: Assessment showing universal MLIPs (M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE) reproduce trends but with systematic errors on defect/surface energetics.

title: Systematic softening in universal machine learning interatomic potentials
finding: Systematic softening: universal MLIPs underestimate forces and energy barriers; fine-tuning/loss reweighting mitigates it.

title: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
finding: Matbench Discovery: community benchmark ranking universal MLIPs on stability prediction; exposes over-stabilization biases.

title: Evaluation of Foundational Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials for Migration Barrier Predictions
finding: Benchmarks five foundation MLIPs (MACE-MP-0, Orb-v3, SevenNet, CHGNet, M3GNet) coupled to NEB against DFT-NEB migration barriers across battery/ionic-conductor chemistries; MACE-MP-0 and Orb-v3 lowest-error, and barrier accuracy found uncorrelated with geometry accuracy.

title: A climbing image nudged elastic band method for finding saddle points and minimum energy paths
finding: Climbing-image NEB locates saddle points and migration barriers; the standard method for computing E_a in solids.
